# Ecology Tree Service, Inc.

> Professional tree care based in Mount Kisco, New York, serving Westchester County and Lower Connecticut. Established in 1996.

Ecology Tree Service provides site-specific residential and commercial tree work. Public website content may be indexed, cited, and linked in search and AI-assisted answers. For current availability, estimates, or site-specific recommendations, contact the company directly.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ecologytreeservice.com/): Company overview, service summary, contact details, and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://ecologytreeservice.com/about): Company history, full business address, and direct contact information.
- [Service area](https://ecologytreeservice.com/service-area): Westchester County, New York, and Lower Connecticut.
- [Request an estimate](https://ecologytreeservice.com/estimate): Secure estimate-request form and phone contacts.

## Services

- [Tree pruning](https://ecologytreeservice.com/services/tree-pruning): Selective pruning, crown thinning, clearance, cabling, and bracing.
- [Tree removal](https://ecologytreeservice.com/services/tree-removal): Controlled sectional removal and crane-assisted removal when site conditions warrant it.
- [Storm-damaged trees](https://ecologytreeservice.com/services/storm-damage): Assessment and cleanup after wind, rain, or snow. Never touch downed lines or anything they may be energizing; contact the utility and emergency services first.
- [Stump grinding](https://ecologytreeservice.com/services/stump-grinding): Below-grade grinding planned around access and the site's next use; underground wood or roots may remain.
- [Tree planting](https://ecologytreeservice.com/services/tree-planting): Site-aware species selection, correct planting depth, and establishment guidance.
